review:
HOT ROCKET 5x 3x 2x is a retro stepper-style slot with nine paylines from BGaming's Rocket Eruption franchise. It's set in a jungle beneath an active volcano.

Rockets can appear on any reel and overlay symbols; collecting a rocket may trigger Jackpot Spins, and the symbols underneath stay active. Random 2x, 3x and 5x multipliers land on different reels: 2x on any reel, 3x and 5x on specific ones. Five jackpots are available. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 2,500x maximum and a 96.1% RTP. It's a nostalgic, land-based style game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
